title: lpm.json
description: Project-level LPM configuration. Sits alongside package.json and provides runtime pinning, env file mapping, task runner config, hosted task cache settings, dev services, local-domain proxy settings, publish targets, and tunnel/HTTPS settings.

env.description:
Env file mapping per script name.
e.g., `{"dev": ".env.development", "staging": ".env.staging"}`

tasks.description: Task configuration for caching, dependency ordering, and outputs.

services.description:
Dev services for multi-process orchestration.
e.g., `{"web": {"command": "next dev", "port": 3000}}`

proxy.description: Dev reverse-proxy configuration for friendly local hostnames.

https.description:
Enable local HTTPS for `lpm dev`.
When `true`, `lpm dev` auto-generates and trusts a local certificate.
Overridden by `--no-https` CLI flag.

publish.description:
Publish configuration for multi-registry publishing.
e.g., `{"registries": ["lpm", "npm"], "npm": {"name": "@scope/pkg"}}`

envSchema.description:
Environment variable schema for validation.
Defines required vars, formats, patterns, defaults, and secrets.
e.g., `{"envSchema": {"vars": {"DATABASE_URL": {"required": true, "format": "url"}}}}`

environments.description:
Named environment definitions with inheritance.
e.g., `{"environments": {"staging": {"extends": "base", "file": ".env.staging"}}}`

cert.description:
Local-HTTPS certificate configuration.

`extra_permitted_dns` entries are validated at parse time and can be
consumed by project-scoped certificate-chain generation.

TaskConfig.description: Configuration for a single task in `lpm.json`.

dependsOn.description: Task dependencies. `"build"` = same package, `"^build"` = upstream workspace deps.

cache.description: Enable local task caching for this task.

outputs.description: Output file globs to cache (e.g., `["dist/**"]`). Required for caching.

inputs.description: Input file globs that invalidate cache (default: `["src/**", "package.json"]`).

env.description: Env mode for this task (e.g., `"development"` → loads `.env.development`).

enabled.description: Enable hosted task cache reads and writes for cache-enabled tasks.

team.description: Organization slug/team namespace. Omit for the authenticated personal namespace.

url.description: Remote cache service URL. Defaults to the configured LPM registry plus `/v8`.

signature.description: Require HMAC tags on downloads and attach them to uploads.

readOnly.description: Read remote artifacts but do not upload newly produced artifacts.

env.description: Controls which loaded environment variables may be used with remote uploads.

RemoteCacheEnvConfig.description: Env safety controls for hosted task cache uploads.

include.description: Variable-name patterns explicitly allowed for remote uploads.

exclude.description: Variable-name patterns that block remote uploads.

allowSecrets.description: Permit secret-looking variable names after explicit project opt-in.

ServiceConfig.description: Configuration for a dev service in `lpm.json`.

port.description: Port this service listens on; omitted host-only services get a stable auto-assigned port.

dependsOn.description: Services that must be ready before this one starts.

readyPort.description: TCP port to check for readiness (defaults to `port` if set).

readyUrl.description: HTTP URL to poll for readiness (2xx = ready).

env.description: Extra environment variables for this service.

restart.description: Auto-restart on crash with exponential backoff.

host.description: Friendly local hostname routed to this service by the dev proxy.

cwd.description: Working directory relative to project root.

host.description: Top-level host routed by the local dev proxy.

port.description: Listen port for the HTTPS proxy. Defaults to 443.

httpRedirect.description: Also listen on :80 and redirect to HTTPS. Defaults to true.

domain.description:
Full tunnel domain (e.g., "acme-api.lpm.llc").
Pro/Org only — free users get ephemeral random domains.

PublishConfig.description:
Publish configuration in `lpm.json`.

Controls which registries `lpm publish` targets and per-registry settings.
CLI flags (`--npm`, `--lpm`) override these values.

registries.description:
Target registries. e.g., `["lpm", "npm"]`.
If absent, defaults to `["lpm"]` (backward compatible).

name.description: Override package name for LPM (must be `@lpm.dev/owner.pkg` format).

Override package name for npm (e.g., `"@scope/pkg"`).
Required if the package.json name starts with `@lpm.dev/`.

access.description:
Access level: `"public"` or `"restricted"`.
Defaults to `"public"` for npm-compatible publishes unless configured.

otpRequired.description: Prompt for OTP before the first publish attempt (saves a round-trip).

name.description: Override package name for GitHub Packages (must be scoped: `@owner/pkg`).
Override package name for GitLab Packages.

projectId.description: GitLab project ID (required for GitLab npm registry URL).

EnvSchema.description:
The full env schema: a map of variable names to their rules.

Deserialized from `lpm.json`:
```json
{ "env": { "schema": { "DATABASE_URL": { "required": true, "format": "url" } } } }
```

EnvVarRule.description: Validation rules for a single environment variable.

required.description: Whether the variable must be set and non-empty.

pattern.description: Regex pattern the value must match.

default.description: Default value if not set (injected at runtime, not written to files).

secret.description: Whether this variable contains sensitive data (redacted in logs).

client.description: Whether this variable is safe for client-side exposure.

description.description: Human-readable description (shown in error messages and .env.example).

VarFormat.description: Built-in format validators for common value types.

EnvironmentsConfig.description:
Named environment definitions with optional inheritance.

Deserialized from `lpm.json`:
```json
{ "environments": { "staging": { "extends": "base", "file": ".env.staging" } } }
```

EnvDefinition.description: A single environment definition — either a file path string or a structured object.

anyOf.description: Structured: with optional extends and file

file.description: The .env file for this environment (optional — may inherit everything).

extraPermittedDns.description:
Additional DNS subtrees the project-scoped intermediate may permit.
Each entry must be a bare multi-label hostname. Wildcards, leading dots,
and non-local TLDs are rejected at parse time.

allowPublicDns.description:
Permit non-local TLDs (e.g. `staging.example.com`) in
`extraPermittedDns`. Off by default — public-internet hostnames widen
the CA's authority and require explicit opt-in.
